topic: Patient perspectives on the Hula Empowering Lifestyle Adaptation Study: benefits of dancing hula for cardiac rehabilitation

sources.title: Patient perspectives on the Hula Empowering Lifestyle Adaptation Study: benefits of dancing hula for cardiac rehabilitation
sources.authors: Maskarinec GG, Look M, Tolentino K, Trask-Batti M, Seto T, de Silva M, Kaholokula JK.

findings.finding: Participants appreciated how hula engaged the body, mind, and spirit together while fostering connections to Hawaiian culture.
findings.quote: Participants recognized that hula's coordination of body, mind, and spirit as a group activity deepened their appreciation of and connections to Hawaiian culture.

findings.finding: Learning song words acted as practical memory cues that promoted ownership of the therapy and reminded participants of lifestyle moderation.
findings.quote: Learning the words of well-known Hawaiian songs provided additional long-term cues that encouraged "ownership" of the therapy and acted as practical reminders of the importance of exercise and lifestyle moderation

principle: Dancing hula as a cardiac rehabilitation exercise offers sociocultural and spiritual benefits that enhance the therapy's value and encourage lifestyle adaptation.
for_the_teacher: Incorporate the cultural background and meaning of the dances into lessons to enhance the learner's connection and appreciation.
